title: Glowing hammer
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#FFA500" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="handle" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D2691E"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#A0522D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8B4513"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="headshine" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C0C0C0"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#A8A8A8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#808080"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softglow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="42" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x="44" y="45" width="12" height="45" rx="4" ry="4" fill="url(#handle)" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight -->
  <rect x="46" y="48" width="3" height="38" rx="1.5" ry="1.5" fill="#DEB887" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Wood grain lines -->
  <line x1="48" y1="52" x2="48" y2="60" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="65" x2="50" y2="75" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="49" y1="80" x2="49" y2="86" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Hammer head -->
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="30" rx="6" ry="6" fill="url(#headshine)" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#softglow)"/>
  <!-- Hammer head top shine -->
  <rect x="25" y="23" width="50" height="8" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#D8D8D8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Front face lighter -->
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="6" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#E8E8E8" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Bottom edge shade -->
  <rect x="20" y="44" width="60" height="6" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#707070" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Warm glow overlay on head -->
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="30" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.15"/>

  <!-- Sparkle/gleam on head -->
  <line x1="32" y1="28" x2="38" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="25" x2="35" y2="31" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="36" x2="64" y2="36" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="34" x2="62" y2="38" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Small glow sparks around -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="25" r="2" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="30" r="1.8" fill="#FFAA00" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="15" r="1.5" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="12" r="1.2" fill="#FFCC00" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="42" r="1.3" fill="#FFAA00" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
